WITH type_averages AS (
    SELECT e.type,
           AVG(1.0 * b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL
      AND b.amount IS NOT NULL
      AND b.amount <> 0
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type,
       avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio,
       avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio - AVG(avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio) OVER () AS difference_from_mean
FROM type_averages;
